meta.from: gcc_blr_site app/globals.css (Tailwind v4 @theme), app/layout.tsx fonts, Epoch night palette

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The club's Epoch night ink, now the only ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, code windows, nav bar. One step above bg.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, inputs, inline code chips. Two steps above bg.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, tooltips: the highest surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders. Not for control boundaries (below 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. 3:1+ on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary copy on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Body paragraphs and descriptions. 9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta lines, dates, captions, placeholders. 5:1 on bg and raised.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The git-green: primary buttons, active nav, commit nodes on main, success. Carried over from the club site.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and the lift shadow on interactive cards.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind green text (status chips, merged badges). Text on it: brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on brand or brand-hover fills. 9:1.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Second commit branch, feature tags, selection accents. The club's lilac node.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind purple text.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Third branch, informational tags, links in prose graphics. Lightened from the club's pale blue.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sky text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rare highlight: featured project, open-to-work signal, warnings. Epoch's coin gold.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and the focus ring. 8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background; text stays text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card gutters on mobile; default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on tablet.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, code window controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project cards, code windows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, nav pills, avatars. The site's most used shape.

shadow.note: Depth is a hard offset block in the accent colour, never a blur. The club's neo-brutal lift, re-inked green.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards and buttons: translate -4px, -4px and add this.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Active state: translate -1px, -1px.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs only: the one soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pulse
tokens.usage: Ring on the 'available for work' dot.
